definitions.explanation: The business of selling goods directly to consumers, as opposed to wholesale trade. Includes shops, department stores, supermarkets, and online retailers.

examples.japanese: {小売業|こうりぎょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びている→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧。
{小売業|こうりぎょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{消費者|しょうひしゃ}→消費者：09866_shouhisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ニーズ→ニーズ：11244_niizu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{敏感|びんかん}→敏感：06641_binkan⟧で⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: The retail business must be sensitive to consumer needs.

notes:
USAGE:
A standard business and economics term. Used in news, business reports, and industry classifications.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小売業|こうりぎょう}{者|しゃ} (retailer)
- {小売業|こうりぎょう}⟦{界|かい}→界：09651_kai⟧ (retail industry)
- ⟦{大手|おおて}→大手：12171_oote⟧{小売業|こうりぎょう} (major retail business)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{卸売業|おろしうりぎょう}→卸売業：16678_oroshiurigyou⟧: wholesale trade — selling in bulk to retailers rather than consumers
- ⟦{小売|こうり}→小売：05084_kouri⟧: retail — the shorter form without {業|ぎょう}
